description: Sabaragamuwa  Provincial Council   -  By-Laws of  Rambukkana   Pradeshiya  Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the approval and enactment of a by-law regulating dangerous and unpleasant businesses within the Rambukkana Pradeshiya Sabha area. It establishes legal requirements, licensing procedures, and compliance standards for business operations, making it a regulatory matter that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
